tagline: An online Pomodoro workspace to focus together
bannedNotice: This account has been suspended and can no longer sign in.

landing.heroTitle:
No video calls.
Just the feeling of working together.
landing.heroBody: PoRoom is an online study room where you run a Pomodoro timer alongside everyone else in your room. From writing web novels to studying for exams to working from home — get the focus of company, without the video call.
landing.ctaHint: All you need is a Google account — takes about 30 seconds.
landing.featuresTitle: What you can do on PoRoom

features.title: Online study rooms
features.desc: No camera, no video call — just walk into a room and feel everyone else working alongside you.

features.title: A synced Pomodoro timer
features.desc: See everyone's focus and break status in real time, so it's easier to stay locked in than working alone.

features.title: Character counts by work
features.desc: Track your writing progress with a per-work character-count chart — it even connects with PomoWriter.

features.title: Chat & whispers
features.desc: Chat freely in the room, or send a private whisper to just one participant when you need to.

features.title: Rankings, duels & challenges
features.desc: See how you rank by character count and focus time, challenge someone to a duel, or join a group challenge.

features.title: Calendar, polls & boards
features.desc: Share your room's schedule on a calendar, gather opinions with polls, and browse the Free / Info / Recruiting boards.

landing.audienceTitle: PoRoom is for you if you're...
audience: A web-novel writer or student who struggles to focus alone
Working from home and missing the presence of coworkers
Trying to build a steady habit with the Pomodoro technique
landing.footerCtaBody: All you need is a Google account — no credit card, no separate sign-up.
